commits.message:
Fix pg-native Pool transactions (#1708)

Co-authored-by: Andrii Sherman <andreysherman11@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Sukairo-02 <sreka9056@gmail.com>
commits.author: NickKelly1
commits.pr_body:
Fixes issue #1707

`pg-native` connection `Pool`s were not working properly with transactions. Drizzle was deciding how to handle transactions based on whether a client is an `instanceof` `pg` `Pool`, but not considering whether the client is an `instanceof` `pg-native` `Pool`.

This PR fixes that by also checking whether the client is a `pg-native` `Pool`.
